provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

ordinary_scattering_model: All four sites have the same real unit scattering amplitude. F_k=sum_j exp(2*pi*i*k*x_j/L),I_k=abs(F_k)^2. This is an ideal one-dimensional periodic coherent-scattering problem with no powder averaging, finite size or instrumental envelope. Coordinates are modulo L.
geometric_equivalence: Compare complete site sets under any common translation modulo L and inversion x->-x; labels/order do not define distinct structures.

contrast_followup.scattering_change: The known anchored site at x=0 has amplitude2 instead of1; all other sites retain1, so add1 to each F_k. Only A and B remain for this contrast choice.
contrast_followup.objective: Maximize abs(I_A_contrast-I_B_contrast), tie within1e-10 by smaller integer k. No contrast outcome has yet been observed.

scope: Ordinary complete integer-index intensities can leave genuinely distinct homometric bases. The controlled anchored contrast removes a stated ambiguity; no claim of a general crystallographic phase solution.
